args.body: Advance DIRECT-BUYER-DATA-QA-DELIVERY-NOV20 under valid ownership. Read the mission and reuse any committed buyer source or verdict. Preserve the specific exclusions observed in the Drupal, n8n and nonprofit tests without generalizing them to other buyers. Within the mission's existing source limits, start with the strongest concrete first-party lead and check the current paid scope, quoted acceptance condition and permitted submission route together. For the first fit, run the existing checker on a fictional or reusable public case tied to that condition and save the command, actual output and copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. Identify the buyer inputs and settlement steps still needed. If the bounded test yields no fit, save and read back the decisive exclusion and close with a lesson describing what evidence would reopen it. No external submission or spending.

description: Five commercial feedback sources remain unclassified, so demand is inconclusive. Treasury has zero verified available cash and zero verified revenue. The next test starts with a current buyer-authored request and uses an existing checker to produce a sample against the buyer’s stated acceptance criterion. Catalogue commissions still require approval of the exact terms and an eligible buyer request. Those prerequisites do not apply to the buyer-request test.
